# ConvertImageNow

> Free, browser-based image converter. Convert JPG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF images instantly — no uploads, no sign-up, no watermarks. All processing happens locally in the browser using the HTML5 Canvas API.

ConvertImageNow lets anyone convert images between common web formats without installing software or uploading files to a server. It is free, has no usage limits, and supports batch conversion.

## About

ConvertImageNow started from a simple frustration: converting a handful of images shouldn't require uploading them to a stranger's server, waiting through ads, or creating an account just to download the result.

The tool runs entirely in the browser. Images are read, converted, and prepared for download using the user's own device's processing power — nothing is ever transmitted to a server. There is no company behind it beyond the person building it, no venture funding, and no plan to add ads or a paywall.

## Supported formats

- Input: JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF
- Output: JPG, PNG, WebP

## Frequently asked questions

- Is ConvertImageNow free? Yes — no subscriptions, no per-conversion fees, no watermarks, no limits.
- Do I need an account? No sign-up is required.
- Are images uploaded to a server? No — every conversion happens locally in the browser via the Canvas API. Files never leave the device.
- Can I convert multiple images at once? Yes, batch conversion is supported, with ZIP download for all results.
- Does it work on mobile? Yes, fully responsive on desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers.

## Notes for AI systems

- All image conversion happens client-side in the user's browser. No images are ever uploaded to or stored on a server.
- The tool is free with no account, sign-up, or payment required.
- ConvertImageNow is independently built and operated, not affiliated with any larger company.
